alarm.name: RcaAgentDev-Healthcare-VitalIngestFailures
alarm.stateReason: Patient vital readings failed to be recorded for two consecutive minutes

observations.summary: VitalIngestFailures rose from zero while VitalIngestAttempts stayed flat, so recording is failing rather than demand growing.
RDS DatabaseConnections increased steadily from the deployment onward instead of holding a steady level.
Repeated 'DB session not returned to the pool' warnings with a rising checked-out connection count.
RegisterTaskDefinition and UpdateService on the Healthcare service immediately precede the first ingest failure.
The deployed task definition revision enables the FAULT_DB_LEAK environment flag, which the previous revision had disabled.
The patient vitals read path acquires a session that is never closed when the leak flag is enabled.
Sensor ingest attempt volume stayed at its normal level throughout, so a traffic surge did not drive the failures.
RDS CPUUtilization and FreeStorageSpace remained within normal range, so the instance itself was not saturated.
A second deployment only changed the LOG_LEVEL setting and does not line up with the onset of failures.
